item.title: The VPN panic is only getting started
item.description:
📝 Murmurings have begun that something needs to be done, that the UK’s flagship child safety law has been made a mockery, and that VPNs are the problem. Ofcom is researching children’s VPN use, but that work will take time. The government has always insisted that it isn’t banning VPNs, and so far that hasn’t changed.
🔗 Read more: https://www.theverge.com/tech/827435/uk-vpn-restrictions-ban-online-safety-act
